# Dr. Manu Gautam - Orthopaedic Surgeon, Noida & Delhi NCR

> Dr. Manu Gautam is an orthopaedic and joint replacement surgeon. He practises at his own clinic at D-8, D Block, Sector 20, Noida (Uttar Pradesh 201301) and is a Senior Consultant in Orthopaedic Surgery at Dharamshila Narayana Superspeciality Hospital, Vasundhara Enclave, New Delhi 110096. This site (drmanugautam.com) is his official website.

## Doctor

- Name: Dr. Manu Gautam
- Qualifications: MBBS (Government Medical College, Bellary); Diploma in Orthopaedics, D-Ortho (Santosh Medical College, Ghaziabad); DNB Orthopaedics (Max Super Speciality Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, Delhi)
- Membership: Indian Orthopaedic Association
- Areas of practice: joint replacement (knee, hip, shoulder), robotic knee replacement, GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate) knee injections, sports injuries and arthroscopy, ACL injuries, fracture and trauma care, spine care, rehabilitation
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Profile page: https://drmanugautam.com/orthopaedic-surgeon/delhi-ncr/dr-manu-gautam/
